messages.subject: picknplot.shape, output files format
parts:
Hello!
I used the function picknplot.shape to obtain the shape corresponding to a clicked point in the area of a PLS plot. However, I could not obtain a PDF file with the corresponding grids because when I tried to save it, the image that is saved shows the PLS plot, not the grids. Can you help me with this? I do not anything about programming, but maybe it is a "bug"?
Thanks in advance!
Alicia

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] picknplot.shape, output files format
parts:
Alicia,

 

The latest version does not have a bug with this. I have just confirmed that the function works as intended (on my Windows machine), and geomorph will save the ‘png’ of the TPS grid. The procedure is:

 

1: run picknplot.shape

2: select a point in the plot

3:  The command window will prompt you asking if you wish to save the plot as a PNG file. Select ‘Y’

4: give it a name (no quotes, as it requests).

 

The help file has additional instructions.


Be sure that you know what directory R is pointing to, as that is where the file will be saved.


Dean

 

Dr. Dean C. Adams
